statusLine.command: input=$(cat); cwd=$(echo "$input" | jq -r '.workspace.current_dir'); session_name=$(echo "$input" | jq -r '.session_name // empty'); cost_usd=$(echo "$input" | jq -r '.cost.total_cost_usd // empty'); dir_name=$(basename "$cwd"); if git -C "$cwd" rev-parse --git-dir >/dev/null 2>&1; then branch=$(git -C "$cwd" --no-optional-locks branch --show-current 2>/dev/null); [ -n "$branch" ] && git_info=" on $(printf '\033[35m')$branch$(printf '\033[0m')"; fi; status="$(printf '\033[36m')$dir_name$(printf '\033[0m')$git_info"; model=$(echo "$input" | jq -r '.model // empty'); [ -n "$cost_usd" ] && cost_fmt=$(printf '$%.2f' "$cost_usd") && status="$status $(printf '\033[2m')$cost_fmt$(printf '\033[0m')"; [ -n "$model" ] && status="$status $(printf '\033[2m')$model$(printf '\033[0m')"; [ -n "$session_name" ] && status="[$session_name] $status"; echo "$status"
